provider: yandex cloud object storage free tier

free_tier.stated: Free every month in standard storage: the first 1 GB of storage, the first 10,000 PUT, POST, PATCH and LIST operations and the first 100,000 GET, HEAD and OPTIONS operations; the first 100 GB of outgoing traffic per month is also free. Unused free amounts reset at the end of the month.
free_tier.notes: In all calculations the page defines 1 GB as 2^30 bytes and 1 MB as 2^20 bytes.

evidence.proved: the first 1 GB of standard storage per month is free
evidence.quote: The first 1 GB of data stored in standard storage per month is free of charge.
In all calculations: 1 GB = 2<sup>30</sup> bytes, 1 MB = 2<sup>20</sup> bytes.

evidence.proved: the first 100 GB of outgoing traffic per month is free
